description: Use when an agent must see who is buying or dumping a Base ERC-20 now (smart money, whales, who bought/sold). Input: token address, optional wallet, minutes (1-240), limit, min_usd, labels=1. Output: JSON signal (smart money vs retail), whale/shark/dolphin/fish flow buckets, who bought/sold, notable wallets, repeat traders, largest swaps, DEX netflow. On-chain only; address ≠ person. Example: ?address=0x4ed4E862860beD51a9570b96d89aF5E1B0Efefed Price: $0.018 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

address.description: ERC-20 token contract on Base mainnet. EOA → 400, non-ERC-20 → 422 (not charged)

minutes.description: Look-back minutes (default 60, max 240); busy tokens may be cut short (window.complete)

wallet.description: Optional wallet to drill into (received/sent/net, DEX bought/sold)

name: base_token_flows
title: Base smart-money tracker: who bought / who sold, whale vs retail flow, labeled wallets, up to 240 min
